QuestInfo.name: Fuji's Intel
QuestInfo.0: Princess Suzume already knew everything you told her. Continue talking to her.
QuestInfo.1: Princess Suzume already knew everything you told her, since she can see the truth of any situation. What she doesn't know, however, is where the Gigatoad's stored her father. She wants you to talk to #b#eFuji#k#n on the #e#r3rd floor of Castle Tower#n#k and see if he has any news.

0.0: I'm sorry, the entire situation is just frustrating. I can see the truth of any situation, so I knew immediately that the man who returned from the fishing trip was NOT my father. But I couldn't tell anyone, because I had no idea where the Gigatoad PUT my father. I couldn't risk the Gigatoad doing something rash. You see my predicament?
0.1: The most important thing right now is to find out where that overgrown amphibian is hiding my father. I sent #b#eFuji#k#n, a friend of mine, to spy on the toad and see what he could discover. Would you go talk to him?

yes.0: Thank you. Fuji should be on the 3rd floor of the Castle Tower. Don't insult his hawk, and you'll get along just fine. Now, leave me here to yell at this brooch, which has the nerve to sit CROOKEDLY in my hair.

no.0: Well, since I'm locked up here and you're not, I suppose there's nothing I can do to make you obey me.

1.0: Fujihawk spies a stranger! Quickly, reveal yourself before he pecks your eyes out! \r\n#L0##bUm, Princess Suzume told me to find you. You're Fuji, right?#l\n#k
1.1: I am he! And this is my best friend, Fujihawk. Come closer. Fujihawk says the ninja are growing suspicious.
